title: eludite.navigation.navigation_bar input
description: The navigation bar above a code editor (Visual Studio's three dropdowns: project, type, member): read it, or choose an entry of the types or members dropdown, which navigates to it. Shown while `editor.navigationBar` is on and the document's server offers symbols.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.
